reconcile.note: Fausset explains that nature's general rule against male long hair admits a lawful exception for the Nazirite vow, since it was a vow of separation sanctioned by God.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Wells treats Numbers 6 and 1 Samuel 1's Nazirite long hair as outright contradicting Paul's verdict that long hair shames a man.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: there shall no razor come on his head… He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
sides.verseText: \"All the days of his vow of separation there shall no razor come on his head, until the days are fulfilled, in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

sides.snippet: Doesn't even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
sides.verseText: Doesn't even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
